kit: Tales of Dorlune coloured-enamel HUD buttons
coordinate_convention: Pixel centres count from 0; bbox right/bottom coordinates are exclusive

size_interpretation.note: The prior 48% figure was relative to the visible 1041 px button, not its 756 px inset. The enlarged 625 px envelope follows that same reference and leaves the carved rim untouched.

known_exception.requirement: Dark-brown outline contrast to the unmodified face >= 3:1
known_exception.reason: The picked dark pressed face has too little relative luminance for any darker outline to reach 3:1; even black reaches only about 2.62:1. The actual brown outline also falls below 3:1 on the normal dark face. Base pixels are preserved.
known_exception.solution: Retain the 6 px dark-brown outline and add a crisp 2 px pale enamel keyline as part of the picture. Report raw and complementary two-tone contrasts separately.

glyph.resampling: nearest neighbour, no interpolation or dithering

contrast.face_sampling: Original base RGBs in the one-pixel 8-connected wood ring just outside the complete picture, including enclosed transparent holes
contrast.effective_boundary_method: For each adjacent face RGB, use max(dark-outline contrast, pale-edge contrast), then report the minimum across face RGBs. This is not a claim that the dark outline itself meets 3:1.
